home.title: LocalDocu — Local-First Document Automation
home.description: Tell it what to do. Your files stay on your device. Merge, split, compress, and convert PDF and Word files locally in your browser.

mergePdf.title: Merge PDF Files Locally & Privately | LocalDocu
mergePdf.description: Merge PDF files without uploading them. Select, reorder, and combine PDFs locally in your browser with LocalDocu.
mergePdf.h1: Merge PDF files without uploading them

mergeDocx.title: Merge Word Documents Locally | LocalDocu
mergeDocx.description: Merge DOCX Word documents locally on your device. Practical merge with clear limits — no document upload to LocalDocu.

compressPdf.title: Compress PDF Locally & Privately | LocalDocu
compressPdf.description: Compress PDF files without uploading them. Reduce size with balanced or maximum modes — processing stays on your device.
compressPdf.h1: Compress PDF files without uploading them

pdfTools.title: Local PDF Tools — Merge, Split, Extract & More | LocalDocu
pdfTools.description: Local PDF tools for merge, split, extract, delete, rotate, reorder, and compress — without unnecessary uploads.
pdfTools.h1: Local PDF tools without unnecessary uploads

docxToPdf.title: Convert DOCX to PDF Locally | LocalDocu
docxToPdf.description: Convert DOC and DOCX to a readable PDF on your device. Complex Word layouts may not be preserved exactly.
docxToPdf.h1: Convert Word documents to PDF locally

offline.title: Offline Document Processing | LocalDocu
offline.description: Work with documents offline after LocalDocu’s app shell is cached. Local processing does not require a network for supported workflows.

privacy.title: LocalDocu Privacy — Local-First Document Processing
privacy.description: Privacy by design: document contents are processed on your device. No document-upload backend and no account required in the current release.

howItWorks.title: How LocalDocu Works | Local-First Document Automation
howItWorks.description: Select files, choose an operation, and run locally. Learn how LocalDocu keeps document processing on your device.

browserSupport.title: Browser & Device Support | LocalDocu
browserSupport.description: What LocalDocu supports on Android Chrome, iOS Safari, and desktop browsers — file pick, folder, Save As, download, and PWA limits.

openSource.title: LocalDocu Open Source | Build in the Open
openSource.description: LocalDocu is open source under Apache-2.0. View the code, roadmap, and how the project is developed in the open.

contribute.title: Contribute to LocalDocu | Open-Source Document Automation
contribute.description: Help build LocalDocu with code, tests, docs, accessibility, and design. Start with issues and the contributor guide.

roadmap.title: LocalDocu Roadmap | Web, Desktop & LocalDocu AI
roadmap.description: See what LocalDocu ships today and what is planned: stronger desktop capacity and LocalDocu AI for intent-driven local document workflows.

desktop.title: LocalDocu Desktop | Advanced Local Document Automation
desktop.description: A future desktop app for heavier local workloads and LocalDocu AI. Positioning only — not available yet. The web workspace remains the product today.

localAi.title: LocalDocu AI | Intent-Driven Local Document Automation
localAi.description: LocalDocu AI runs in the desktop app: an open-weight, on-device model that reads document metadata and user intent, then drives LocalDocu document management — without sending document contents to the cloud. Not active in the current web release.
localAi.h1: LocalDocu AI: planned for the desktop app

faq.title: LocalDocu FAQ — Privacy, Offline & Formats
faq.description: Common questions about LocalDocu, privacy, supported files, offline use, open source, and contributions.

notFound.title: Page not found | LocalDocu
notFound.description: This page does not exist. Return to the LocalDocu workspace.
